title: Release Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0 RC0
summary: zhjwpku proposed release candidate 0 of Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0, based on commit ae29c3d4. Several +1 votes followed. stevenzwu voted +1 but reported that dev/release/verify_rc.sh failed out of the box on recent macOS because the vendored avro-cpp pins fmt 10.2.1, which no longer compiles under Apple Clang 21; installing a newer fmt with Homebrew worked around it. wgtmac and zhjwpku said this is a known issue already fixed upstream in avro-cpp (apache/avro PR #3788) and will go away when the dependency is bumped. manuzhang pointed out that the RC source builds with a 0.3.0-SNAPSHOT version, which a REST client would send in its User-Agent header; zhjwpku agreed and opened iceberg-cpp PR #705. zhjwpku then aborted the vote to fix both issues and prepare RC1.

positions.stance: Votes +1; the verify script fails on recent macOS because the vendored avro-cpp pins fmt 10.2.1, which is not a blocker but needs a follow-up.
The fmt problem is already fixed in avro-cpp, which now uses std::format, and will disappear once the avro-cpp version is bumped.
An RC should not carry a SNAPSHOT suffix in its version, since a REST client built from it would send iceberg-cpp/0.3.0-SNAPSHOT as User-Agent.
The RC source should not build as 0.3.0-SNAPSHOT; both that and the vendored fmt verification issue will be fixed in RC1.

outcome.note: The release manager aborted the vote because of the -SNAPSHOT suffix in the CMake version string and a verification issue caused by the vendored fmt version; RC1 is to follow. Only +1 votes had been cast.
